question: Should OpenClaw accept persistent pending ambiguous delivery rows for channels without unknown-send reconciliation once no-op deferrals no longer consume replay pacing?
rationale: This changes how existing ambiguous queue rows behave across upgrades and restarts, trading terminal failure for later recoverability while affecting message-delivery recovery ordering.

options.title: Accept after pacing fix
options.body: Keep the recoverable pending-row behavior, but require a pre-merge fix proving no-reconciler deferrals do not spend replay pacing or recovery deadline budget.

options.title: Keep fail-closed main behavior
options.body: Close or pause this PR and leave unavailable-reconciler ambiguous rows moving to failed until a fuller delivery ledger/reconciler design lands.

options.title: Land with explicit risk
options.body: Accept the current pacing and pending-row behavior as an intentional operator tradeoff, with follow-up work for broader delivery-ledger design.

recommendation.title: Accept after pacing fix
recommendation.body: Keep the recoverable pending-row behavior, but require a pre-merge fix proving no-reconciler deferrals do not spend replay pacing or recovery deadline budget.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work under commit 741d9524 rewrote the same outbound recovery contract across core and bundled channels.
